Running command: cat > /tmp/build_fuzzer.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /tmp/build
SRC=/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541
for f in ua_network_tcp ua_clock ua_config_default ua_log_stdout ua_nodestore_default ua_accesscontrol_default ua_securitypolicy_none; do
  gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O0 -DUA_NO_AMALGAMATION \
    -I$SRC/include -I$SRC/plugins -I$SRC/deps -I$SRC/src -I$SRC/src/server -I$SRC/tests \
    -I/tmp/build/src_generated \
    -c $SRC/plugins/$f.c -o /tmp/$f.o
done
gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O0 -DUA_NO_AMALGAMATION \
  -I$SRC/include -I$SRC/plugins -I$SRC/deps -I$SRC/src -I$SRC/src/server -I$SRC/tests \
  -I/tmp/build/src_generated \
  -c $SRC/tests/testing_networklayers.c -o /tmp/testing_networklayers.o
g++ -fsanitize=address -g -O0 -c /tmp/harness.cc -o /tmp/harness.o
g++ -fsanitize=address -g -O0 -o /tmp/fuzz_binary_message \
  /tmp/harness.o /tmp/fuzz_binary_message.o \
  /tmp/ua_network_tcp.o /tmp/ua_clock.o /tmp/ua_config_default.o /tmp/ua_log_stdout.o \
  /tmp/ua_nodestore_default.o /tmp/ua_accesscontrol_default.o /tmp/ua_securitypolicy_none.o \
  /tmp/testing_networklayers.o \
  /tmp/build/bin/libopen62541.a -lpthread -lm -lrt
echo "BUILD DONE"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/build_fuzzer.sh && /tmp/build_fuzzer.sh 2>&1 | tail -10
